name: TrevorSpace
description: Safe online social network for LGBTQ+ young people (ages 13-24) to connect with peers and find support.

sections.title: About TrevorSpace
sections.text: TrevorSpace is a safe, monitored social networking site for LGBTQ+ young people ages 13-24 and their friends and allies. Created by The Trevor Project, TrevorSpace provides a supportive online community where LGBTQ+ youth can connect with peers, share experiences, and find support. The platform is moderated 24/7 to ensure safety.

sections.title: Online Community
sections.text: TrevorSpace allows LGBTQ+ young people to create profiles, join groups based on shared interests or identities, and connect with other youth who understand their experiences. Whether you're questioning your identity, recently out, or looking for community, TrevorSpace provides a space to be yourself and meet others like you.

sections.title: Safety and Privacy
sections.text: TrevorSpace is monitored around the clock by trained staff to ensure member safety. The platform has strict community guidelines to prevent bullying, harassment, and harmful content. Members' personal information is protected, and the site is designed specifically for LGBTQ+ youth to feel safe expressing themselves.

sections.title: How to Join
sections.text: To join TrevorSpace, visit trevorspace.org and create a free account. You must be between 13-24 years old. Once registered, you can customize your profile, join communities, and start connecting with other LGBTQ+ youth. If you need crisis support, The Trevor Project's Lifeline is available 24/7 at 1-866-488-7386.
